title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and use face masks over time under social influence, policies, messaging, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe peers’ mask use and update their adoption propensity via threshold/weighted influence.

interactions.name: household_influence_and_sharing
interactions.description: Household members influence each other’s norms and share mask stock.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies; non-compliant persons may be denied entry or fined based on enforcement strictness.

interactions.name: messaging_campaign
interactions.description: Government and media broadcast messages that shift risk perception and perceived norms.

interactions.name: purchase_transaction
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers given availability and price; subsidies reduce effective prices.

interactions.name: supply_chain_restocking
interactions.description: Retailers restock inventory subject to capacity and schedule, influencing availability.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Daily proportion of people wearing masks.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption reaches at least 50%.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption fraction observed and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_last_30_days
metrics.description: Mean mask adoption during the final 30 days of the simulation.

metrics.name: compliance_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average compliance rate within each location type, conditional on policy level.

metrics.name: stockout_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of retailer-days with zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Between-group disparity in adoption (e.g., Gini or variance by SES).

metrics.name: policy_violations_per_capita
metrics.description: Average number of non-compliance incidents per person.

metrics.name: cost_per_percentage_point_adoption
metrics.description: Public cost (subsidies, enforcement) per 1 percentage point increase in adoption.

validation_criteria.name: bounded_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate remains within [0,1] for all timesteps.

validation_criteria.name: inventory_non_negative
validation_criteria.description: Retailer inventory levels never drop below zero.

validation_criteria.name: reproducibility
validation_criteria.description: Identical outputs when rerun with the same random seed.

validation_criteria.name: stylized_s_curve
validation_criteria.description: With moderate peer influence and no mandates, aggregate adoption exhibits an S-shaped diffusion curve.

validation_criteria.name: policy_monotonicity_sanity
validation_criteria.description: Holding other factors constant, increasing enforcement generally does not reduce near-term adoption.

validation_criteria.name: extreme_case_checks
validation_criteria.description: With zero supply or extremely high prices, adoption remains near zero; with universal mandates and perfect enforcement (and adequate supply), adoption approaches one.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_stability
validation_criteria.description: Key metrics (e.g., adoption rate) change less than 5% over the final 10 days.
